name: The study type qualifies all its facts
name_fr: Le type d'étude qualifie tous ses faits

seen.excerpt: MESURÉ le 08/08/2026 sur les 272 articles XML JATS de (internal corpus of 272 JATS articles) : 90/272 résumés (33 %) nomment explicitement leur dispositif (randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, retrospective, cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, meta-analysis, in vitro/in vivo) — une seule ligne qui qualifie tout l'article. Observé aussi le 08/08/2026 sur Gomersall & Stuart, J. Neurol. Neurosurg. Psychiatry 1973 : « a double-blind controlled clinical trial of crossover design was conducted in 26 volunteers ».
seen.excerpt_en: MEASURED on 2026-08-08 on the 272 JATS XML articles of the internal corpus: 90/272 abstracts (33 %) explicitly name their design (randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, retrospective, cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, meta-analysis, in vitro/in vivo) — a single line that qualifies the whole article. Also observed on 2026-08-08 on Gomersall & Stuart, J. Neurol. Neurosurg. Psychiatry 1973: "a double-blind controlled clinical trial of crossover design was conducted in 26 volunteers".

repair.note: an extra label can be deleted, a missing one cannot be added

measured.note: 3,932 of 3,932 reached, and 12,591 true facts were lost with them: the repair deletes the nodes, not their labels
measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

obstacle.reason: Reached in full, and at a cost: the repair deletes the nodes rather than their labels. The information that would put the label right is in the node itself — the identifier says the type — and one statement of the graph's own query language sets it back with nothing destroyed.
obstacle.reason_fr: Atteinte en entier, et à un prix : la réparation supprime les nœuds plutôt que leurs étiquettes. L'information qui remettrait l'étiquette droite est dans le nœud lui-même — l'identifiant dit le type — et une instruction du langage de requête du graphe la repose sans rien détruire.
obstacle.source: derived from what a deletion-only repair can express, read in the repairer's own code — its solution is a set of elements to delete and carries no insertion — together with the measurement of 2026-09-10. Per damage class, not per form.
